name: review-radar
description: Review pane for the human in the loop: summarizes your branch changes and shows, with their diff, only those that need a person (business logic, architecture, data, secrets, third parties, security, infra, likely mistakes); the rest goes to the PR.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane and of the summaries and findings: en (English) or es (Español).

reviewModel.title: Review model
reviewModel.description: Model for the deep review. If it cannot answer (no access, blocked, API error), sonnet is used instead and the summary says so.

autoAnalyze.title: Analyze automatically
autoAnalyze.description: Analyze at the end of every turn that changed files. Off: only /review-radar and the Re-analyze button run an analysis (and spend tokens).
